cards.lore: Decreases perceived power imbalance. Sitting signals you have nowhere else to be, even if you only have 2 minutes.
cards.power: The Level-Setter. Refuses to stand, dissolving the Authority Wall.

cards.lore: Proves signal received; encourages the patient's Initial-Sprint without interruption.
cards.power: The Validation-Loop. Repeats the last 3 words of the wrestler's sentence.

cards.lore: Avoids the Framing-Trap; catches the Actual-Problem instead of the expected one.
cards.power: The Story-Scoop. Never asks Yes/No. Shuts his mouth for 60 seconds.

cards.lore: Affect labeling effect. Naming a Vague-Emotion moves activity from the Fear-Center to the Logic-Center.
cards.power: The Storm-Soother. Doesn't fix the problem; names the feeling.

cards.lore: Cognitive load reduction. If Lore is too complex, the Wrestler ignores the Pill-Manual outside the arena.
cards.power: The Jargon-Crusher. Uses Human-Words.

cards.lore: Autonomy-Bait. Wrestlers are far more likely to wear the armor they choose to walk into battle.
cards.power: The Option-Offer. Offers two viable moves.

cards.lore: Normalizes non-adherence. Removes the Guilt-Default to find the Real-Reason.
cards.power: The Doubt-Digger. Digs for the hidden No.

cards.lore: Evokes internal motivation. Wrestlers must find their own Why.
cards.power: The Spark-Howl. Asks readiness scale (1 to 10) instead of barking orders.

cards.lore: Information Titration. Dumping Malignant-Max news all at once shuts down the Brain-Basket.
cards.power: The Quill-Retract. Delivers Heavy-Truth in slow, checked pieces.

cards.lore: Parasympathetic mirroring. If the Strategist-Stays in Recovery-Mode, the Aggressor self-deregulates to match.
cards.power: The Calm-Gravity. Absorbs Rage-Rhythm without Damage.

cards.lore: Manages tolerance of Uncertainty. Shifts goal from Immediate-Answer to Safe-Observation.
cards.power: The Wisdom-Pause. Proves Time-the-Healer is better than a Radiation-Blast.

cards.lore: Goal Alignment. Shifts from Disease-Centered to Dignity-Centered care.
cards.power: The Graceful-Exit. When the Terminal-Clock runs low, Shifts Peace Instinct of Winning.

cards.lore: The Curse of Knowledge. Jaguar assumes fluent High-Linguistic code, unable to follow the Playbook.
cards.power: The Language-Labyrinth. Leaves wrestlers in a Daze-Confusion, unable to follow the Playbook.

cards.lore: Non-verbal Shut-Down signal. Tells the wrestler their Story-Illness are not worth the Doctor's time.
cards.power: The Time-Theft. Stands ready to exit, applying Urgency-Pressure.

cards.lore: Dominance-based care ignores personal values, breeding Internal-Resentment.
cards.power: The Dictator-Bear. Gives Orders, not Choices. Treats wrestler like a Servant-Hamster.

cards.lore: Counter-transference. the own Frustration-Sparks hide the Real-Antagonist behind Behavioral-Mask.
cards.power: The Pattern-Lock. Labels patient Drug-Seeking, shutting down the Differential-Engine.

cards.lore: Proxy-Interference; requires Sideloading the Gorilla to hear the true patient narrative.
cards.power: The Narrative-Block. Answers every question, hiding the Wrestler's-True-Signal.

cards.lore: 10x safer than Family-Member-Funnels; beats the Lost-in-Translation-Glitch.
cards.power: The Cultural-Cabling. Translates meaning and Lore, not just the Story-Swap.

cards.lore: Vulnerability-Credibility. Trust-Armor protects the partnership when tests come back negative.
cards.power: The I-Don't-Know Move. Admits missing Name-Tags for the enemy.

cards.lore: Closes the loop; shifts responsibility from the Wrestler's-Memory to the Strategist's-Explanation.
cards.power: The Echo-Check. Asks patient to explain the Pill-Move back to them.

cards.lore: Core of medical ethics. the Wrestler owns the Ring, even if the Doctor disagrees.
cards.power: The Sovereign-Flight. Wrestler has Final-Say over their Body + Soul.

cards.lore: Duty to act in Patient's interest, the primal Healer-Impulse.
cards.power: The Protective-Hug. Always acts to increase Health-Tokens.

cards.lore: Ensures Arena-Resources are shared fairly across the entire Social Map.
cards.power: The Fair-Scan. Defeats Hierarchy-Walls so the Poor-Wrestler gets the MRI-High-Tech.

cards.lore: Primum non nocere, the primary Safety-Brake of the Hippocratic.
cards.power: The Venom-Block. Slaps Aggressive-Surgical Options if Risk > Gain.

cards.lore: Put down the clipboard, look them in the eye. They aren't a Case, they are a Wrestler. Stay fluffy!
cards.power: The Soul-Connector.
